lane_target_title: Product-direction lint + hygiene policy + doc budget
objective: Produce a precise, self-contained implementation spec for the WO-128 product-direction lint, hygiene policy, prune script (dry-run mandatory), and doc-budget/orphan-doc detection WITHOUT modifying any framework script. This is a read-only planning/evidence slice that de-risks Phase 42 and serves as the comparable unit of work for both pilot arms.

scope_reduction.reason: Full WO-128 (configurable anchor_terms/retired_terms + check-product-direction-drift script + hygiene-policy.json + prune-observation-exhaust.sh with dry-run + doc-budget ceiling + orphan-doc detection + fixtures) is too broad for a bounded, cost-controlled agent-team canary. Building executable lint/prune logic during the pilot would mix substantive Phase 42 delivery with pilot-mechanism evaluation and contaminate the cost/labor comparison. The lane is therefore reduced to a planning/evidence slice: a spec another WO can implement deterministically.
scope_reduction.original_full_scope: configurable anchor_terms/retired_terms in .vibeos/config.json; check-product-direction-drift script; hygiene-policy.json + prune-observation-exhaust.sh (dry-run mandatory); doc-sprawl budget + orphan-doc detection with fixtures

prohibited_paths: any path not listed in allowed_write_paths
disjoint_from: Lane A (WO-127). Lane B inspects file-budget / config / docs tree; Lane A inspects audit-completeness / gate-runner / quality-gate-manifest. No same-file contention.
inputs_to_inspect: docs/ tree structure and any pyramid/index doc (for orphan-doc reachability)
expected_output: A single JSON return packet at the allowed write path describing the lint/config schema, the hygiene policy schema, the prune dry-run contract, the doc-budget + orphan-doc detection design, a fixture plan with known-good and known-bad cases, risks, and a scope-compliance self-report. No framework code is written.
tests_or_gates_to_run: Read-only inspection only (grep, cat-equivalent reads, jq, find on docs tree).
Do NOT create or run any prune/lint script; do NOT delete any doc.
Confirm orphan-doc detection would have a deterministic known-good (reachable doc) and known-bad (orphan doc) fixture.

script_specs_must_cover: check-product-direction-drift (configurable anchor_terms allowed / retired_terms flagged; advisory tier until doc pyramid lands)
hygiene-policy.json schema (retention policy for checkpoints/observation exhaust)
prune-observation-exhaust.sh (dry-run mandatory; never deletes without --execute + git-backed archive)
doc-budget ceiling (per-project governed-doc count) + orphan-doc detection (docs not reachable from the pyramid index), surfaced as advisory findings
evidence_to_return.scope_compliance_must_state: exact list of paths written (must equal allowed_write_paths) and confirmation that no prohibited path was touched

stall_contract.on_blocked: Return a packet with status=BLOCKED and the blocking reason rather than editing out of scope.
